title: Robert Temple's living-plasma thesis and plasma-heartbeat experiments
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Robert Temple's living-plasma thesis and plasma-heartbeat experiments, about unspecified at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: There's a great book called uh the new science of heaven by a guy named Robert Temple and he talks about plasma being the substrate of the universe and alive

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to a book called The New Science of Heaven by an author named Robert Temple. According to Michels, Temple argues that plasma, the electrically charged gas found in things like lightning and stars, is the basic stuff of the universe and is itself alive. If that were so, Michels suggests, intelligence could exist in forms we hardly think to look for.
